fact: MyBroadband's Starlink status table lists Malawi as Available on 17 July 2026 (Starlink satellite internet on sale); the article gives no provider other than Starlink and no date of launch.
TechnoMag lists Malawi among the Starlink markets 'Active Now' in mid-2026; no date of launch is given, so the article's publication date is used.
CIO Africa lists Malawi among markets that approved Starlink quickly (without a local-ownership barrier); no date, licence type or regulator is given, so the article's publication date is used.
Le360 lists Malawi among 29 African countries where Starlink (SpaceX) had been granted a licence as of May 2026; no licence date or regulator is given for Malawi, so as_of is the article date.
The Independent (Uganda) states Starlink is already operational in Malawi, among other countries, extending connectivity to rural areas; no date given, so as_of is the article date.
Macra's director general cites the licensing of Starlink as creating competition on the market.
